sections.title: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
sections.text_before_clauses: No registered non-profit organisation, carrying out advancement of any other object of general public utility, shall carry out any commercial activity unless,—

clauses.text: such commercial activity is undertaken in the course of actual carrying out of advancement of any object of the general public utility;
the aggregate receipts from such commercial activity or activities do not exceed 20% of the total receipts of such registered non-profit organisation of the relevant tax year; and
separate books of account are maintained by such registered non-profit organisation for such activities.

orphans.text: Restriction on commercial activities by registered non-profit organisation, carrying out advancement of any other object of general public utility.
